naval_notes.availability: Official Dock queue items require the Vietnamese private dock (which inherits the Chinese dock) and relevant stock unlocks. scar_ageN tag is classification evidence, not a direct proof of a training gate.
naval_notes.dock_queue: The seven units above appear in official production queue; Vietnamese dock introduces no local ship queue override. An internal naval scout construction reference is not treated as player-trainable.
naval_notes.transport_actions: No crew dialogue inferred. Ship-level transport actions limited to movement/select/acknowledge/under-attack; no combat payload assumed.
naval_notes.fireship_actions: Detonate exists in stock fireship SPD; inclusion here records a context, not proof of action routing or runtime playback.
naval_notes.repair_garrison: Trade ship SPD includes structureRepair and garrisonUnits/unloadUnits. Applicability depends on engine routing and stock ability availability, not proven for all units. No local Vietnamese-specific override found.
naval_notes.verified_speakers: Official extracted ship SBPS establishes explicit speaker codes: fishing boat=tradeShip; transport=scoutShip; combat ship=ship; war galley=ship; combat warship=warShip; trade ship=tradeShip; fireship=fireShip. SPD inventory is the selected profile bank, not proof of behavior/runtime.
naval_notes.fishing: Fishing boat resolves to tradeShip SPD; this decoded SPD includes resourceFish. The role bank may remain NAVAL_FISH, but binds to tradeShip stock speaker data.
naval_notes.transport: Transport resolves to scoutShip SPD; contexts include movement/select/acknowledge/underAttack, enemySpotted and structureRepair. No warfare weapon contexts found in that SPD.
naval_notes.military: NAVAL_MILITARY covers two distinct stock speaker codes, ship and warShip; keep their profile mappings split in the script metadata or explicitly mark a shared creative bank.

army.campaign_starting_force: same composition in campaign variant; compare source around lines 680-688
army.notes: Seven unit entries including six villagers and one scout/one elephant; the list also includes five sheep at lines 321-325 (excluded from speech roster). Production building list is empty in the army definition. Campaign list has same counts.

scar.spawn_evidence: Squad_CreateAndSpawnToward(elephant, player.id, 0, elephantPos, center) at line 66; spawned squad identifier is a war elephant. No other unit spawn APIs found by targeted search.

official_speech.source: Installed SoundSpeechChinese.sga; selectively listed/extracted only 8 SPD files into research_tools/stock_profiles; SHA-256 and decoded summaries included under profiles.
official_speech.decode_status: speech helper emitted structural_readback_only; no qualified audio/playback/runtime proof. Chinese villager SPD parse failed Invalid media list; raw files retained with hashes where extracted.
official_speech.contexts: Suffixes cLowest/cLow/cMed/cHigh and iNorm/iHigh/iStealth were observed but their chronology/delivery interpretation was not traced; preserve as unverified.
official_speech.extraction_note: Nine SPD members were selectively extracted from the installed SoundSpeechChinese.sga (eight original profiles plus scoutship); no large audio asset extraction. Structural readback only.

excluded_or_unresolved: No custom Vietnamese naval unit SBPS/EBPS roster found; all seven ship queue entries are stock Chinese units inherited through Vietnamese dock.
Official Attrib MCP lookup miss is not evidence of invalid data.
Stock scoutfemale SPD exists; private vn_unit_scout_1_chi female_chance must be read from source and reconciled with attachment inheritance before using SCOUT_F.
Official siege/shop and trader queue references are stock consumers, but full effective inheritance chain requires further resolution.
Current ship/siege separate physical crew actors and their potential dialogue are not proven.
No voice-bank chronology mapping inferred from suffixes.

source_resolution_notes.private_attachment_speaker_overrides: No attachment_speaker_code override was found in the surveyed Vietnam SBPS/EBPS XML. Inherited male/female attachment/speaker selection remains unresolved.
source_resolution_notes.local_direct_metadata: All 43 SBPS entries expose hash and local line evidence. Only directly serialized squad_speaker_code/name/race/female chance values are reported. Missing values are inherited/unset, not evidence of no voice or gender variant.
source_resolution_notes.profile_key_semantics: voice_role_profile names creative bank role only. Parent can key selected bank and donor speaker separately; this file does not assert a validated engine mapping.
source_resolution_notes.attachment_speaker_overrides: Surveyed all Vietnam EBPS and SBPS XML for attachment_speaker_code; no explicit private override found. The EBPS speaker_code fields are separately listed under private_ebps_speaker_fields; inherited attachment speaker logic is unresolved.
